contract.population: All signed-up users, free and paid. Configuration analytics eligibility is separate from paid sync/access entitlements.
contract.inventory_first: Read existing account/provider league settings, manual settings and saved RSO rule/scoring contracts before proposing new storage. Reuse authoritative settings where appropriate; record gaps and owners rather than assume a new table.
contract.minimal_data: League configuration only: league type and format, relevant settings, roster slot/position limits and rules. Exclude private player rosters, transactions, account tokens, credentials and unnecessary personal identifiers. Define the minimum identity needed for ownership, deduplication and versioning.
contract.scoring: Normalized canonical scoring categories plus original provider labels, mapping provenance and explicit custom/unknown categories. Separate points, categories, roto and H2H formats. Preserve scoring values including real zero versus missing/null; record units and applicability rather than fabricate defaults.
contract.versioning: Provider/manual provenance, configuration/rules version, effective and observed time, and source identity. Define changed settings and multiple-league handling without overwriting historical meaning.
contract.aggregation: Deduplicate users sharing one league and repeated observations; separate configuration counts from user counts. Assess sampling/selection bias across provider, format, free/paid, season and observation coverage. Audit category coverage including unknown mappings. Review privacy, retention/deletion and aggregation disclosure before data use.
contract.outcome: Analysis to inform future default-setting proposals and category-coverage audits. No automatic change to user settings or product defaults from unqualified samples.
contract.authority: Design and synthetic fixtures only. No retroactive private-league export, live collection, migration drafting/application assumed, new tables, production reads/writes or implementation lease before design acceptance.
